You have arrived in Fortuna.

On the continent of Fortuna, everything is decided at the table.

Put your luck and skill to the test.

Countless rivals await your challenge.

Do you have the nerve to draw one more card?

In Fortuna, every contest is settled through blackjack.

Draw your cards and choose your outcome.

Will you claim a great victory, or lose everything to greed?

There's more than one plan for victory.

Don't despair just because your hand is weaker than your opponent's.

The outcome can be swayed from places you'd never expect.

Make clever choices and find another opening.

Your Choices Change the Game

Who to fight, where to rest, what to take and what to leave behind. In Fortuna, every decision is yours.
Buy cards and trim the weak ones at the shop, enchant a single card into your own weapon, and catch your breath at the tavern.
The path you walk becomes your deck, and your deck shapes the next showdown.

YOUR CARDS CHANGE YOUR GUN

A revolver that chains lightning. A saw thrower that freezes enemies. Draft a card after every floor and change how you fight.



SOULLOOP combines fast first-person combat with deckbuilding in a steampunk underworld. Fight through procedurally generated floors, combine cards into powerful builds, and spend the souls from failed runs on permanent upgrades.

CLEAR A FLOOR. PICK A CARD. BUILD YOUR RUN.

Three cards after every floor. One choice. Evolve your cards and combine their effects to shape your fighting style.



  • 42 card families, each with two evolution paths
  • Seven Selves that fuse in pairs into hybrids: MUNITIONS, PRECISION, REACTION, CATACLYSM, FLESH, GUILE, QUICKSILVER
  • 30 rule cards and 70+ relics for new combinations every run
  • 27 inscriptions and the Tempering House to refine your build

EIGHT WEAPONS. YOUR FIGHTING STYLE.

  • 8 weapons, from THE LAST RITE to CAPACITOR CHOIR, each with a signature mechanic
  • 31 right-click Vent abilities, including forge-only variants and redline-only Master Vents
  • The ABSOLVE finisher and a throwable hammer for when you need to get personal

EIGHTEEN FLOORS, SIX ACTS, ONE WAY DOWN

Descend from the Showroom through the Toxic Refinery, Frozen Reactor, Bone Cathedral and Furnace to the Heliosol Core.



  • Over 30 enemy types, 6 minibosses and 6 bosses with attack patterns and weaknesses to learn
  • Procedural floors and a Daily Trial: the same seed and starting conditions for everyone

DEATH IS A DEPOSIT

Your souls stay banked when you die. Spend them in the Soul Forge: 130+ permanent upgrades across eight signs that carry into your next descent.

WHAT TO EXPECT FROM THE DEMO

The free demo is out now. It covers the first act: three floors, two guns to choose from and the act's boss at the bottom. The full game expands the descent with more environments, weapons and card combinations.

EARLY ACCESS

SOULLOOP is in active development. Your feedback helps improve combat feel, the first-time player experience and future content. See the Early Access section above for the current state of the game and planned improvements.

A NOTE ON AI

Some art and audio in SOULLOOP were made with AI assistance under human direction. Nothing is generated while you play.

Let's SPIN !!

SPIN HEROES is an action game centered around a Rogue-lite RPG combined with spin physics combat! Players must throw their heroes at the perfect timing and use ultimate skills to defeat enemies!

You will build your own ultimate team to break enemy armor, stagger them, or... knock them completely out of the arena! Discovering how to combine the unique traits of your heroes to create your own exclusive setup is the most exciting part of SPIN HEROES!

In battle, you are not just a spectator, but the conductor who decides the exact moment to unleash an "ultimate skill"! By striking when the enemy is at their weakest, you can deal massive damage to their weak points! Even if the enemy is a giant boss several times your size, it's no problem at all! Now, let's join together and Let's SPIN !!

In a remote rural area lies "Spin Village", where the ancient and powerful "Spin Combat" is hidden. Legend has it that even ordinary civilians can unleash dozens of times their normal strength through this fighting style.

However, evil will inevitably set its sights on such power...

On what should have been a peaceful afternoon, Tarian, a young boy from Spin Village, was receiving training from the village chief. Suddenly, with a loud crash, the evil Dr. Spin appeared with his spinning weapons, attempting to steal the secrets of Spin Combat. Although the residents of Spin Village were all highly skilled, they were ultimately no match for the power of a regular army and were defeated.

The protagonist, seen as the possessor of Spin Combat, was knocked down into a valley... What kind of changes will occur in the male protagonist's future, and will Spin Combat fall into the hands of evil!? It's up to you to find out!

- A new kind of Action RPG experience! Throw your heroes spinning into the arena and defeat as many enemies as possible in the shortest amount of time!

- An innovative Rogue-lite RPG experience where you can choose different types of stat bonuses and change classes during battle! Swordsman → Knight → Paladin! Turn your characters into truly powerful heroes!

- Team compositions allow you to freely unleash various effects. Want to quickly strip the enemy's armor? You need a Thief companion for armor-breaking assists! Want to clear the board quickly? You need a Mage companion capable of wide-range area damage!

- Deep character progression! Defeat enemies to collect a variety of equipment and weapons, some of which can even trigger powerful set effects!

• Auto-Chess Based Synergy System Each unit has its own unique class and race (attribute). Deploy units that meet specific conditions on the battlefield to activate hidden synergy effects and exponentially boost your combat power.

  • Strategic Tower Defense Analyze the enemies' movement paths and attack types to position your units in the most efficient locations. Precise formation building, considering unit attack ranges and skill areas, is crucial.

  • Ever-Changing Combat Dynamics No one knows which units will appear in the shop that refreshes after every wave. Quick thinking and sharp judgment are required to find the best unit combinations under given circumstances and with limited resources.


          

  • Elaborate 2D Pixel Art Encounter a variety of units and monsters designed with 2D pixel art graphics that capture both a retro vibe and a satisfying sense of impact.

STARZ.PEG is a Y2K physics roguelike built around chain reactions. Buy blind-box figures called STARZ between rounds, line up your shot, and set off whole rows of abilities to run up the score.

  • Fixed cannon: 10 balls per level. Set your angle and let gravity do the work.

  • Stack the triggers: Hold up to 5 STARZ at once. Chain their abilities into single-shot board clears.

  • Compound scoring: Build your Rush multiplier with yellow pegs, multiplied further by your total hit count on every bounce.

  • 12 escalating boards: Progress from Noon to Midnight as board layouts tighten and target scores ramp.

    Glossy Y2K interface, aurora skyscapes, frosted glass, liquid chrome, and early-2000s nostalgia.

Start from the historical world of 1934, generate an entirely new world, or reshape the map yourself. Create nations, redraw borders, move capitals and alter provinces, then take control of any country and let the simulation run.

Its population needs work and goods. Its industries need energy and resources. Its government needs money. Its armies need manpower, equipment and supply. Other nations pursue their own interests, react to threats and opportunities, form alliances and fight wars of their own.

There is no predetermined story. The systems of STATO create one.

Create Your World

The map is part of the sandbox.

Play with the historical borders and strategic situation of World 1934, generate a procedural world filled with original nations, or customize the political landscape before beginning your campaign.

Redraw borders, create and customize countries, choose capitals and modify provincial conditions. Then press play and watch your new international order develop under the same political, economic and military simulation as any other campaign.

A tiny state can become an industrial power. An empire can collapse under its own weight. New alliances can overturn the balance of power. A border drawn in the editor can become the cause of a war decades later.

Govern the State

A country is more than its borders.

Shape its laws, institutions and political priorities. Manage political power, stability and the competing interests placed on government.

Reforms can transform a country, but change takes time. Political decisions affect the economy, society, diplomacy and your ability to prepare for war.

Build an Economy That Can Sustain Your Ambitions

National power ultimately depends on what your country can support.

Manage taxation, expenditure, treasury reserves and sovereign debt. Develop provinces, expand infrastructure and electrical generation, secure strategic resources and build an industrial base capable of supporting both civilian life and military expansion.

Industry depends on real inputs. Energy shortages reduce productivity. Resources feed industrial production. Consumer demand affects the civilian economy. Trade connects countries and allows local disruptions to spread beyond their borders.

Economic growth is not simply a factory count. Population, infrastructure, resources, energy, market access and industrial capacity combine to determine what your country can actually produce.

Compete for Resources and Markets

Iron, coal, oil, rubber, grain and other strategic resources connect domestic development to international politics.

Import what you lack, export what you control and build industries that transform raw resources into greater economic and strategic value.

Global prices respond to supply and demand. Wars, blockades, industrial expansion and disrupted production can alter markets far beyond the countries directly involved.

A resource shortage can become an economic crisis. A trade relationship can become a strategic dependency.

Turn Industry Into Military Power

Design equipment, research technologies, organize divisions and assign factories to armament programmes.

Military strength must actually be produced.

More sophisticated armies require larger industrial and logistical systems to sustain them. Equipment must be manufactured, manpower mobilized and losses replaced.

The army you can deploy tomorrow depends on the economy you build today.

Conduct Diplomacy in a Changing World

Every country evaluates the world through its own interests, relationships, threats, ideology, geography and relative power.

Improve relations, negotiate military access, sign non-aggression agreements, create alliances, guarantee other countries, manage subjects or pursue territorial ambitions.

Your actions change how other governments perceive you. Aggression creates infamy. Growing military power creates fear. Wars can draw alliances into conflicts that neither side originally intended.

And while you make your plans, every other country is making its own.

Plan Wars Across Thousands of Provinces

Organize armies, establish frontlines and draw operational plans across a detailed province-based world.

Terrain, organization, equipment, planning, entrenchment and attacks from multiple directions influence combat. Infrastructure, supply networks and ports determine where armies can operate and how long offensives can continue.

At sea, construct fleets, protect trade, raid convoys, blockade hostile territory and support invasions.

Winning the battle is only part of winning the war.

Occupy, Integrate or Exploit

Conquered territory does not instantly become productive national land.

Occupation, compliance, resistance, integration and economic damage determine what you can actually extract from your victories.

Subjects can rebel. Civil wars can divide countries. Independence movements can create new states. Empires can fragment long after their greatest military victories.

The political map remains mutable throughout the campaign.

Watch History Emerge

STATO does not require the world to follow a predetermined script.

Economies grow and contract. Governments change. Nations form alliances, declare wars and pursue their own ambitions. Countries can collapse, divide or emerge from territory that once belonged to someone else.

Events and dispatches record what happens as the simulation creates a political history unique to that campaign.

Sometimes you will cause it.

Sometimes you will simply watch it happen.

Key Features

  • Create nations and redraw the political map

  • Historical World 1934 scenario with 26.000 provinces

  • Procedurally generated worlds and original nations

  • Detailed province-based simulation

  • Dynamic population and economic development

  • Laws, institutions, political power and stability

  • Taxation, public spending, treasury reserves and sovereign debt

  • Consumer goods, energy and resource-dependent industry

  • Dynamic international trade and resource markets

  • Research, equipment design and military production

  • Division design, frontlines and battle plans

  • Infrastructure and logistics-driven warfare

  • Naval construction, fleets, convoys, blockades and invasions

  • Diplomacy driven by interests, threats and relative power

  • Alliances, guarantees, subjects and territorial demands

  • Occupation, resistance, integration and independence

  • Scenario customization, saved campaigns and mod support

Create the world. Govern the state. Live with the consequences.

A carrier does not die in one pass

Enemy carrier armour comes in three layers. Knock out the perimeter turrets and the shield generators are exposed. Drop the generators and the core opens. The order is fixed and there is no shortcut through it.

The other side is doing the same thing to you. Your carrier has turrets, generators and a core of its own. Fifteen minutes on the clock, and the match is decided by where you put your four fighters while both hulls come apart.

You fly as four

Every sortie is a flight of four. Your wingmen are not scenery - they hold roles. Recon, Support, Engineer, Assault, Jamming, Supply. Six aptitudes, and who you take changes how the fight goes.

The comms panel carries their voices. Who is being shot at, who needs help, what got intercepted off the enemy channel. You can fight without reading it. Reading it makes the next decision faster.

Switch to the cockpit view and each nation has its own glass instrument panel. Its screens carry the radar, hull and weapon readouts, and change colour for a lock-on warning, a carrier bombardment or heavy damage.

200 parts

Fifty engines, fifty armour sets, fifty primary weapons, fifty secondaries. Each nation flies its own airframe, and you fill its four slots. Speed, turn rate, armour and firepower all trade against each other, and the hangar shows you the before and after side by side.

Nine paint schemes. Two are free from the start and the rest are bought with gold earned in play. Nothing else is sold for money today.

Ten machine leviathans

Thirty hunts, against ten species of machine. Each has three escalating variants. Their weak points are sealed behind each other in order, and they open one layer at a time.

The leviathans are alive. They writhe even at rest, flinch when hit and wind up before a big attack, and each species has its own growl.

From the second hunt on, the boss also charges a bombardment at your home carrier, at 20, 40, 60 and 80 percent of the mission clock, each one worth a quarter of the carrier's core. Hit its weak points during the ten-second charge and the shot breaks and the boss staggers. Fail to, and the carrier can be lost and the hunt with it.

Where you fight

Ten space arenas. Rock density, rock size, the angle of the sun and where the cover sits all change between them, so a tactic that worked in one does not simply carry to the next. There is also a low-altitude stage over a planet surface. Every arena also carries a bonus objective, for anyone with the margin to chase it.

Modes

  • Carrier Assault — 4v4, fifteen minutes, both carriers coming apart.

  • Surface Assault — low-altitude combat over a planet.

  • Campaign — twelve missions, unlocked in order.

  • Missions — thirty machine leviathans.

  • Story — The Carina War, twenty-four chapters across three nations.

  • Flight Training — the controls, one at a time.

  • Practice — targets and a sparring partner, nothing else.

  • Team Deathmatch — 4v4 with no carriers. First to twenty kills wins, or whoever is ahead at eight minutes.

Online 4v4 versus, and online co-op raids where up to eight players fly on the same side against one machine leviathan. Offline, bots fill the empty seats, so all of it can be played alone.

Three nations

Astra, Helion and Vestra. Carrier hull colours, fighter markings and twenty-four pilots differ between them. You pick your allegiance on the fleet screen.

Languages

Japanese, English, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Korean, Russian, Spanish, Brazilian Portuguese, German and French. All interface text and the Story mode's dialogue are localised.

Let's cook your brother!

A quick jab with the syringe, chop chop with the knife, squish under the pickling stone.

Use every tool in the kitchen on your brother!


Survive every step and dinner is served: steak, meat buns, dried fish, katsuobushi, popcorn. He's never looked tastier.

Rewrite his lines, slurp up the magic

Your cooking magic comes from food words mixed into his lines. Can't find one? Make one with magic cards. Even his plea "I don't want to die!" turns into "I don't want to pie!" with a single letter.


Careful, though: dirty jokes sneak into his lines too. Slurp one up by mistake and your cooking tool explodes, so click it and smash it first.

Rewrite every conversation with magic!

Buy magic cards, collect runes, and rake in the magic. "See off" sees every C off the line and turns it into cash. The right word combos keep making you stronger.

Cook 7 dishes including Meat Bun, Steak and Cream Bun, plus 2 minigames, for free. Grab it with "Download Demo" on this page. Demo saves don't carry over to the full game.

# Your Own Little Aquarium, Right on Your Desktop.

SUGICHIN'S AQUA PARADISE is a cozy idle aquarium game where you raise tropical fish while you work, breed unique offspring, discover rare mutations, and create mysterious chimeras.

Relax and watch your fish swim, or dive deeper into breeding and collecting unusual species.

## 🐠 Your Fish Keep Swimming While You Work

Watch colorful tropical fish drift peacefully across a little corner of your screen. Whether you're working or watching videos, your aquarium is there to brighten your desktop.

## 🥚 Every New Fish Is a New Discovery

Collect, raise, and breed tropical fish. Each new offspring brings possibilities, including the chance to discover rare mutated fish.

## 🧬 Fish + Fish = Something Unexpected?!

Combine fish with other fish, decorations, or aquatic plants through Chimera Fusion to create extraordinary creatures unlike ordinary tropical fish.

## 📖 Collect, Discover, Complete Your Encyclopedia

Discover different fish and unusual variations as you build your collection. Every new discovery gives you something to look forward to.

## 🌿 Make Your Aquarium Your Own

Customize your tank with aquatic plants and decorations. Create a one-of-a-kind underwater home for your favorite fish.

## ✨ Features

- A cozy idle aquarium on your desktop

- Collect and raise a variety of tropical fish

- Breed fish to discover new offspring

- Find rare mutations

- Combine fish and items through Chimera Fusion

- Unique fish behaviors and animations

- Customize plants, decorations, and backgrounds

- Build your fish and chimera collections

## 🌊 A Little World of Life on Your Desktop

It's relaxing to watch, but once you start breeding fish, you'll always wonder what might hatch next.

Enjoy a cozy aquarium full of little discoveries.

The Sun King has called to you. The Briar King, god of the underworld, has taken the Sun King's daughter, and as the sun dims the briar spreads across the country.

Before she was taken, the princess scattered eight Sunstones and hid them under the old tombs. Their guardians still hold them. Recover the stones, restore the orb at the mountain summit, and go down into the underworld to bring her home.

COMING AFTER LAUNCH: CO-OP FOR UP TO FOUR

THE DESCENT is a co-op mode in development for SUNSTONE, planned as a free expansion after launch. Up to four heroes take on wide tomb arenas together, wave after wave of foes, with elites to bring down as a party, under one shared camera that pulls back to keep everyone in view.

  • Couch co-op for 2 to 4 players on one screen, one gamepad each.

  • Play online with friends through Steam Remote Play Together: only the host needs the game.

  • Full online play follows in a later update.

Co-op is not part of the Next Fest demo or the launch version. Wishlist SUNSTONE to hear when it arrives.

A CARTRIDGE YOU CAN WALK AROUND IN

SUNSTONE is an 8-bit adventure at heart: four-way sword play, tile-by-tile rooms, secrets in the walls, all of it seen in 3D. Every overworld screen is stood up as a diorama from the game's own picture of it, and every tomb room is built from its own map.

  • The orbital 3/4 view. A camera that swings around the hero with Q and E, lifts over the treeline and cuts away the walls in front of you.

THE ADVENTURE

  • Nine tombs, eight Sunstones. From THE HOLLOW to THE BEACON and beyond, each tomb has its own puzzles, its own treasure and its own guardian.

  • Guardians you have to read. Hornhead must be set alight before your sword can bite. Others have to be outthought, not outfought. Every guardian has tells, phases and a way to beat it.

  • A whole country. Start in the village of Sunhome and travel through deep woods, a purple thornwood, red mesas, a lake you cross by raft, snowfields and the road up the mountain.

  • Tools that open the world. Sword, shield, boomerang, bombs, bow, lamp, raft, ladder and more, each one a key to somewhere you could not reach before.

  • Secrets everywhere. Bomb the walls, cut the grass, follow the clues on the stones.

  • A second quest waits after the tale is told.

TODAY'S TOMB

A daily challenge on the title screen. Every day the game deals one tomb, the same for every player, with one rule from five: THE TOMB AS IT STANDS, HALF YOUR EMBERS, A DULL BLADE, THE TREASURE IS GIVEN, or NO LAMP. Walk in at the door with the day's kit and race to the guardian's fall. Your first run each day is official; after that you can practise.

HOW IT PLAYS

  • Keyboard and mouse, or a gamepad: twin sticks in 3D, with the triggers to swing and throw. A pair of Joy-Cons is read as one controller.

  • Battery saves with CONTINUE, an options menu with three difficulty settings, and the spin attack and lift-and-throw as switches you can turn off.

  • A Chronicle of the story so far, a full instruction booklet, and eight languages: English, Simplified Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Spanish, Brazilian Portuguese, Italian and French.

Draw Directly in 3D Space! Your Imagination Is Your Greatest Tool!
A Party Game Where Everyone Can Shine!

SUPER GAHAKU is a drawing party game where you create 3D sculptures by combining pieces in a 3D space to bring a given topic to life.

The key isn't how well you can draw—it's how creatively you can think!

You set out to make a cat, but somehow end up with a bizarre creature. You try to make a car, but for some reason, all you get is a giant box...

You know what you want to create, but somehow, it just doesn't turn out the way you imagined!

That's all part of the fun. Even the simplest ideas and the most unexpected creations can get everyone laughing!

You don't need to be good at drawing. Express yourself in your own way and make everyone laugh or surprise them with your creations!

■ Simple and Intuitive Controls

Just place 3D pieces in space and start creating.

No complicated controls or difficult rules to learn.

Even if you're not good at games, anyone can jump right in and have fun!

■ 3 Game Modes

🎨 Build & Guess (Players: 2+)

Bring a given topic to life in 3D, then see if everyone can guess what you've made!

Choose between Co-op Mode, where everyone works together to guess, and Competitive Mode, where players race to answer first.

Topics range from simple ones like "Cat" and "Car" to quirky challenges like "An apple Sitting on the Toilet" and "A gorilla that Slipped on a Banana Peel."

Customize the settings to suit your group and enjoy 3D drawing your way!

Whether you create a masterpiece or completely fail to make what you had in mind, the more things go hilariously wrong, the more everyone laughs!

🕵 Drawing Imposter (Players: 3+)

One player doesn't know the topic... and they're pretending they do!

Everyone else knows what they're supposed to make and must create their sculpture without giving the topic away.

The Drawing Imposter has to watch everyone else, bluff their way through the round, and try not to get caught!

"Do they actually know the topic...?"

When the sculptures are finished, discuss, accuse, and vote to find the Drawing Imposter.

Bluff your way to victory, or expose the imposter in this 3D twist on the classic social deduction game!

🧱 Free Build (Players: 1+)

No time limit. No topic. Just create whatever you want!

Take your time and create whatever comes to mind.

Make a giant structure, work on an elaborate masterpiece, or just mess around and see what happens.

Enjoy creating your own 3D sculptures at your own pace.

※ Drawing rapidly at the same time with many players may affect performance.

■ Have Fun with Your Friends!

You’re not just here to create artwork on your own.

Look at your friends’ creations and try to guess what they were trying to make, suspect who the Drawing Imposter is, and laugh together at the finished masterpieces.

It’s not about being the best artist. It’s about having fun together.


Online multiplayer in this game is based on player-created rooms that other players can join.

  • Join through your Steam Friends

  • Join using a Room Code

Random matchmaking with strangers is not supported.

Create a room, share the code with your friends, and play together!

■ Customize Your Avatar

Dress up your avatar, show off your personality, and join your friends!

■ For Streamers & Content Creators

Made to be played together and shared with a laugh.

Create ridiculous 3D sculptures, guess what your friends made, and watch everything go hilariously wrong.

Whether you're playing with friends or streaming to your audience, we hope you'll have a great time!

Streaming, gameplay videos, and other content featuring SUPER GAHAKU are welcome, including monetized content.

■ Who Is SUPER GAHAKU For?

  • Anyone who loves party games with friends

  • Anyone looking for a game that makes everyone laugh

  • Fans of drawing and guessing games

  • Fans of crafting and creative games

  • Fans of social deduction and bluffing games

  • Players who want something fun and easy to pick up

  • Anyone who loves weird, silly games that make you say, "What even is that!?"

So... What Will You Create?

Grab your friends, start creating, and see what you end up with!

A conveyor belt sushi shop on your desktop

SUSHI PARADE runs in a transparent window laid over your desktop, so the lane and its plates pass in front of whatever you have open. The game only takes clicks on its own parts: the lane, the characters, and any open menu. Click anywhere else and it goes straight to the app behind.

Want it out of the way? Run a single lane along one edge of the screen, or turn off Always on Top and let your other windows cover it.

A small shop that keeps itself busy

Chefs make sushi and send it down the lane. Customers come by, each with their own tastes, budget, and appetite, eat what they like, and pay in coins. You can click a plate to eat it yourself or carry it to someone. There is no way to fail.

When you feel like doing more:

  • Orders: accept the ticket above a customer's head and the chef makes that sushi first. Filling it pays extra coins and EXP.
  • Hand swap: right-click the lane to change hands. Glutton vacuums up nearby plates, Serving Hand sends a plate to a customer, and God Breath freezes a plate so customers leave it alone.
  • Time away: sales from up to 8 hours are waiting when you next open the game.

Small things happen, too. Empty plates pile up on the rack. A plate nobody eats grows wings and a halo and floats away. And Shari Ryman, who left a trading company to open this shop, sometimes murmurs, "…I still can't throw out my business cards."

Over 100 entries to collect

The Sushi Dex holds over 100 entries: sushi from Tuna (Lean) to Fatty Tuna Belly and Monkfish Liver, plus sides and a la carte dishes such as rice bowls and noodles. Each entry comes with its own description and a comment from Shari.

New sushi opens up in Neta Dev ("neta" means the topping). It branches across lineages and rarities: eat enough of one kind, save up coins, and the next comes within reach.

As the game goes on, you can drop one Single (a one-piece plate) onto another on the lane, and certain pairs become one of about 60 Combos. Further along, you can stack those into Super Combos (4 or 6 pieces) and Mega Combos (8 pieces), about 50 in all.

Rarely, a plate comes by as Shiny or Golden and sells for more. Rainbow plates appear only after you have eaten a lot of that sushi and claimed the reward.

Make the lane your own

Over 20 lane shapes unlock as the shop grows: one line along the bottom, a U, a ring in the middle of the screen, a loop that nearly circles the monitor. As the game goes on, Lane Craft lets you draw your own on a grid. Warp parts (Glitch, Black Hole, Spring, Edge Warp) send plates from one stretch to another.

Warp parts need a Fixed layout, which works only at the screen size it was made on. Relative layouts fit any size.

Over 50 lane skins change the look, including Hinoki Flow, Koi Garden Pond, and Choo-Choo Railway. Invisible draws no belt at all, leaving only the plates moving across your desktop.

Around the lane, you can place furniture such as a Noren Curtain, Red Lantern, Goldfish Bowl, or Cat on a Cushion, and a food sample of any sushi you have eaten many times. As the shop grows, you can also build karakuri: machines, with looks like Saucer Express and Crane Express, that deliver sushi from the lane to faraway customers.

Streaming and technical notes

Feel free to stream SUSHI PARADE or post videos of it. Monetization is fine, and there is no need to ask for permission. If you capture a window, turn on Streamer Mode in Settings to show the game as a normal window with a background.

SUSHI PARADE has no servers or accounts of its own and sends no analytics. It goes online only through the Steam client, for Steam Cloud saves and Steam's server clock (used for daily bonuses and limited-time events). Links such as "Share on X" open in your browser only when you press them. To tell whether a click should land on the game, it reads the cursor position; it does not monitor your keyboard.

Because the game layers a transparent window over your desktop, a small number of antivirus programs may warn about it on first launch. Overlays may also conflict with the anti-cheat software used by some online games, such as Vanguard or EasyAntiCheat, so we recommend quitting SUSHI PARADE before playing them. On macOS, Screen Recording permission is requested only if you use the Desktop background for screenshots.

SWOM — a new story-driven survival game with magic, created by a solo developer.

You find yourself in a strange, mystical world where you must survive harsh conditions.

Explore the Open World: Wander through dark forests, investigate ancient ruins, descend into mysterious caves, and uncover the secrets of diverse biomes.

You are alone in a completely new world. Every artifact you find is not just an item, but a fragment of your personal history: past, present, and future. Who left these symbols for you? Why?

Surprisingly, you don't remember how you ended up in this mystery-shrouded world, and you don't know who you are. But your body remembers:

  • How to start a fire to save yourself from paralyzing cold and soul-crushing hunger.

  • How to avoid threats from dangerous approaching creatures.

  • How to steady the trembling in your hands before drawing your first magical symbol.

Here, magic is more than a list of spells. It flows within the earth; it must not be memorized, but felt intuitively. You do not repeat ancient formulas; you transform them, creating your own charms.

Your Primary Objectives:

  • Gathering: Search for food, water, plants radiating magical energy, valuable minerals, and other survival supplies.

  • Building & Crafting: Construct reliable shelters from wood and stone, craft tools, weapons, and armor to help you withstand dangers.

  • Survival Stats: Monitor your health, stamina, hunger, and thirst. Keep your body temperature stable, especially at night when the cold becomes a serious threat.

SWOM World Features:

  • Dangerous Creatures: Various beings inhabit this land, some of which pose a threat to you.

  • Dynamic Weather: Unpredictable atmospheric phenomena create additional challenges.

  • Day and Night Cycle: Darkness makes the dangers of this world feel all the more immediate — it is best to stay in shelter at night.

  • The Sinister Green Moon: Appearing in the sky from time to time, it heralds "The Hardest Hour": a dangerous period when the deafening silence heightens your fear of what you might encounter, until all you can hear is the ringing in your ears.

As you play, you will gain new skills, magic keys, and improve your gear — all of which will help you survive and get closer to the main mystery of this game.

Your shelter is not just a roof over your head. It gives you the strength to keep going. Use everything you find. Protect your home with spells you create by combining basic magical forces.

SWOM has a storyline, but completing it is optional — you are free to choose your own path:

  • Some will build a house just to live and pass the time.

  • Some will go deep into the forest to find that very answer.

  • Some will wait until finally, some sound breaks through the silence.

SWOM is not just survival. It is a game about your destiny, hidden in the twilight of a mysterious world.

P.S. The game is developed by one person. The world is inspired by tundras. Everything in the game is a work of fiction, not a reflection of the developer's life or your own in another universe.

Both hands flip at once.

SYNTAX WARS is a simultaneous-reveal duel. Each turn, both sides lock in a hidden move, then reveal at the same time. No reflexes. No combo tables. Just reading the other player.

Play solo

The full game includes VS CPU (with difficulty settings), arcade (five fights in a row), and challenge runs (No Guard, No Signature, and a clear with all six fighters, with Steam Achievements).

A free demo is available. It includes 3 of the 6 fighters — NEXUS-7, SHADOW, and BLAZE — in VS CPU and local 2-player.

The triangle, and more

The core is a triangle of Strong, Weak, and Guard.
  • Strong beats Weak
  • Weak pierces Guard
  • Guard parries Strong
On top of that, every fighter shares the same special actions and special attacks, and each has a unique signature move. A challenge run, No Signature, is played without them.

There is no best move. There is only "what will they pick?"

Six fighters

  • NEXUS-7 — The Elite Enforcer. A learning android that grows stronger the longer it fights. An all-rounder.
  • SHADOW — The Phantom Assassin. The fastest fighter, built around aggression.
  • TITAN — The Iron Juggernaut. The slowest and the toughest. Wears you down under pressure.
  • NOVA QUEEN — The Quantum Empress. Gets more dangerous as her health drops. Built for comebacks.
  • LYRA-X — The Bio-Aberration. Chips away with corrosion and holds on with regeneration.
  • BLAZE — The Detonator. Charges up, then unleashes a heavy hit that can answer a bad read.

Play with a friend

Local 2-player on the same screen is included. Remote Play Together is also available, so you can play with someone who is not in the same room.

Story

The setting is a cyberpunk exhibition tournament. The prize is a sealed AI called ARCHITECT.

Buy once

One purchase includes everything. No ads. English and Japanese. Windows, macOS, and Linux.

A Sci-Fi Visual Novel meets Turn-Based Strategy with spaceships battling on an 8X5 grid. Command your half of the battlefield as you manage upgrades and limited resources. Success depends on choosing the right tradeoffs at the right moment to progress through the story.

Story

As a military escort crew, your mission is to protect convoys and keep supply routes safe from pirate attacks. But something is wrong. The attacks are no longer random, but precise and coordinated. As the conflict escalates, the truth begins to unravel. What everyone assumed to be pirates at the beginning becomes a horrific realization that the enemy was something far more malicious. What started as a basic military operation turns into a conspiracy that could leave a sinister intelligence ruling the known universe.

Gameplay

Battles take place on a compact 8X5 battlefield with constant engagement. Every unit is within attack range, making positioning, timing, and resource management critical.

Each encounter is designed to be fast-paced and decisive. No filler, no grinding, just meaningful tactical scenarios.

Each unit begins with a core role:

  • Attacker

  • Sniper

  • Warship

  • Medic

But how they function is defined by how you build them. Customize their abilities, movement, and equipment. Whether your ships are armed with overwhelming firepower, impenetrable defense, or a focus on a balance, you have complete control on how you upgrade and manage your fleet.

Combat System

Abilities consume two key resources: Energy and Charge.

Stronger abilities can strike multiple targets, break enemy formations, or do massive damage. But every action comes with a cost. Success depends on managing your resources and choosing the right tradeoffs at the right moment.

SaboTour is a chaotic asymmetric party racer for up to 6 players.

Up to five Racers battle it out on a procedurally generated track,

drifting through corners and fighting for the podium. But they're not

alone — one player is the Saboteur, watching everything from an

observation tower at the center of the track.

From up there, the Saboteur picks their moment and strikes:

  • ICE BOMB — freeze the road and send racers sliding into the walls

  • CHICKEN FLOCK — release a stampede that scatters across the track

  • DRIFT TRAP — punish anyone who dares to drift through the zone

Every checkpoint is a target. Every lap is a gamble. Racers win if

even one of them crosses the finish line — but the fastest still

earns bragging rights on the leaderboard. The Saboteur wins if the

clock runs out first.

No two tracks are the same — every race generates a brand new course,

so the Saboteur can never rely on the same tricks twice.

FEATURES:

  • Asymmetric multiplayer: up to 5 Racers vs. 1 Saboteur

  • Procedurally generated tracks — a new layout every race

  • Physics-based drift racing

  • Three distinct sabotage abilities with real strategic timing

  • Built for quick, chaotic sessions with friends

In Sabre Hunter: Keep On Moving, a third-person action game, you take on the role of a young agent of the Counterintelligence Operations Department. You will face internal conspiracies and ultimately take part in the largest battle of the near future.


KEY FEATURES

  • Deep Fencing System. You can strike from any direction, posture, and state. An enemy swinging a sword at your head? Crouch and cut their legs. An enemy keeping their distance and refusing to let you close? Leap over their head with a flip and slice them in half. Surrounded from three sides? Swing sideways and drag the mouse to slash everyone around you.

  • Intuitive and Responsive Movement & Parkour System. Responsive controls let you stay in full command of the fight. Sprint, dash, jump, wall‑kick, flip – all of it, together with the combat system, makes every fight spectacular. Nothing can hold you back.

  • Deep Story. A story that immerses you in a completely new world – the 31st century, where humans are no longer the only intelligent beings on the planet. After countless wars, rats have evolved into thinking creatures and built new cultures. Some have integrated into human cities, while others have forged their own empires. Your megacity‑state is locked in a prolonged war with one such power.

  • Deadly Arsenal. Where the blade cannot reach, lead will carve the way. As you progress through the game, new weapons become available: an assault rifle, a sniper rifle, a shotgun, a pistol with high‑caliber and explosive rounds, as well as conventional and incendiary explosives.

YOU ARE A KIDNAPPING VICTIM

After a wild party with your coworkers, you wake up in the basement of an old castle — chained like an animal.
Darkness, occult symbols, and the remains of previous victims surround you. Why were you chosen?
Why did the cult single you out? Questions you don’t yet have answers to — and ones you must uncover yourself.

DECIDE YOUR FATE

Will you try to escape the Satanists' lair and find out why you were the victim? Will you save another victim… or only yourself? Or perhaps begin to see the cult from a different perspective? The choice is yours in Sacrificium

YOUR MENTALITY WILL BE TESTED

Every decision you make has consequences. What seems logical at first may lead to unexpected outcomes, and your choices will shape your fate. To survive in this cursed place, you'll have to do things you'd never normally consider — and some of those choices may slowly destroy your sanity. But you are not alone. The whisper in your ears keeps guiding you forward. Is it helping you survive... or have you already lost your mind?

FEATURES

⛧ Psychological horror with multiple endings.

⛧ An interactive text adventure set in the lair of Satanists.

⛧ Choices that affect sanity and health.

⛧ Atmospheric retro-inspired visuals.

⛧ Occult and satanic themes

Loose the string from a galloping horse

You are an archer on horseback — not a hunter who walks up, kneels, and steadies the shot. The ground under you never stops moving. Your horse's speed and heading are your difficulty setting, and a good rider works the animal into the angle they want before they ever draw.

Seven minutes. One bow. One score.

Every ride is a single round. The forest fills with game at the start, the clock runs for seven minutes, and what you bring down is your score. Nothing to loot, nowhere to escape to — ride well, shoot well, and get on the board.

Three forests, day and night

  • Solgol — deer, moose, rabbit, fox, raccoon. They run.
  • Metjae — boar, bull moose, stag. Hit them and they come back at you.
  • Beomgol — wolf, cougar, bear. Strike first, or don't strike at all.
Every forest has a day version and a night version. Night is the same ground and a different problem.

Made for VR

  • Nock, draw, and release with your own hands
  • Leaderboards for every map
  • A bestiary that fills in as you hunt
  • Korean and English interface

The Empire stole your flagship. Your crew is in chains. Take them back.

Sails of Salt is a pirate sandbox with an ending. Every voyage opens a new sea: plunder, hunt, trade or run contracts. The more you raid, the sooner the Empire comes for you. What you bring home stays: your hidden bay grows and your next captain sails from the same quay.

Fight with wind, waves and broadsides.

Read the wind, ride the swell and line up the perfect broadside. Shred their sails, smash their hull or sweep their deck.

Capture ships. Command your fleet.

Why sink a ship you could steal? Board her, take her and add her to your fleet.

Every hand has a face. Every voyage leaves its mark.

Recruits become seasoned specialists. Wounds leave scars, choices move morale, and every face tells your story.

Outfit every ship for its role.

Find blueprints, refit your hull and make every ship your own, down to her name and colours.

No two voyages sail the same sea.

A new world rises from the waves: islands, harbours, wrecks, imperial forts and stranger places still. Where you go and what you do there is up to you.

Bring your loot home.

Free the Salt-Sworn, the crew who once sailed your flagship. Only in the Caldera, a hidden haven inside a smouldering volcano, are they and your gold truly safe. Rebuild it between voyages and watch it grow with every homecoming.

Monster hordes have swept through towns, looting every last treasure in their path. The Saintess calls upon heroes to launch a counterattack before the invaders make their retreat. Become one of these heroes, fight alongside a saintess, collect cards and build your deck to bring unexpected twists and surprises to every battle. Auto-battle puts strategy front and center — grow stronger with each clash and take back all that belongs to humanity.

Easy to Start, Play Anytime

No complicated controls required — play with just your mouse as battles unfold fully automatically. Each run lasts 20–30 minutes and can be paused whenever you like, perfect for unwinding tense nerves.

Hero & Saintess Dual Combinations

Distinctive heroes paired with uniquely skilled saintesses. Mix and match freely to spark entirely different tactical playstyles.

Grow Stronger Through Combat & Strategic Choices

Defeat enemies and claim an ace card for your own deck. Play it safe and steady, or take a bold, risky gambit? The call is yours.

Roguelike + Cards = Endless Possibilities

Over 200 unique cards, and every choice can turn the tide of battle. Random events and randomized rewards unlock fresh surprises with every run.

ONE HOMESTEAD. ONE FAMILY. THREE CENTURIES.

Build a home, make a living, and leave the next generation something worth inheriting.

Guide one family through life on the American frontier in a turn-based colony sim spanning 1607–1900. Each turn is a year: put your household to work, develop your homestead, and decide how to meet the changes arriving at your doorstep.

MAKE A LIFE IN A WORLD THAT KEEPS CHANGING

Towns grow, borders shift, and trade routes change. Wars, migration, gold rushes, and the arrival of the railroad transform the continent over nearly three centuries. Watch history unfold on a map of North America as your family finds its place within it.

New settlements bring new neighbors. Changing markets create opportunities and risks. Plan for the year ahead while adapting to a world that keeps moving beyond your fields.

BUILD A HOMESTEAD THAT CAN OUTLIVE YOU

Grow crops, raise livestock, build workshops, and trade what you produce. Divide your family's labor between immediate needs and plans for the future. Every new building takes resources; every task needs someone to do it.

Expand production, improve storage, or prepare for leaner years. Decide what to keep, what to sell, and what your household can afford to risk. The home you build becomes the next generation's starting point.

Your neighbors matter, too. Trade and cooperate with nearby settlements and Indigenous nations, build relationships, and deal with tensions and bandit threats that can disrupt your plans.

WATCH YOUR FAMILY BECOME A DYNASTY

Children grow up. Marriages bring families together. Deaths leave gaps in both the household and its workforce. Personal traits and relationships make each generation a different family to guide.

When one leader's life ends, an heir takes over the homestead. Follow births, marriages, and succession in your family tree as a handful of names becomes a story stretching across generations.

BRING THE YEAR'S TROUBLES TO THE FAMILY TABLE

Every year ends with a Family Council. Life on the homestead and events in the wider world become decisions about people: whom to help, what to risk, and which future to pursue.

Welcome a newcomer, invest precious resources, or send a family member away to learn a trade. Your choices can change the household's resources, its relationships, and who will be there when the next year begins.

The years pass. The family grows and changes. What will the next generation inherit?

Salt of the Earth is an isometric medieval settlement builder about a single manor held by charter, and the families who live on it. Houses rise from hovel to town house when the household inside is fed and looked after. Workshops take their labour from the houses within walking distance. Every building has to touch the road network.

The year turns through four seasons, and nothing grows in winter, so the food stored before it has to last until spring. Traders, tithe collectors, couriers from neighbouring towns and raiders all turn up at the manor, and the neighbouring towns remember how you dealt with them.

Key Features

  • More than forty buildings, all of them on a road — From a hovel and a well up to a cathedral, a keep, and border outposts on the edge of the shire. Placement determines output: a workshop draws its workers from the houses near enough to walk, so a yard two streets too far from housing stands idle while the one beside it runs full.

  • Housing that upgrades as needs are met — Four tiers, hovel to peasant house to half timbered house to town house. A household moves up a tier when its needs are met: food, water, a market in reach, a church, an inn, a school for the children. Variety counts as much as quantity, and a family living on bread alone eats through it far faster than one with bread, meat and fruit on the table. Families whose needs go unmet leave, and the yard behind the house goes unworked.

  • No research tree — Each building unlocks once a building it depends on is standing: the bakery needs a mill, the tower needs a barracks, the school needs a church and a half timbered house, the goldsmith needs a town house. Industry can only grow as far as the housing does.

  • Twenty eight goods and the chains between them — Grain to flour to bread, ore to iron to tools, clay to tiles, grapes to wine, wool to fabric. Surplus sells at the market square, and any good can be forbidden outright so the town stops eating what was meant for sale.

  • Seasons and weather — Food is grown and stored from spring to autumn so the manor can get through the winter. Rain, hail, snow and thunderstorms come and go, and rain helps put out fires.

  • Over fifty decision events — Each one brings someone to the manor with a request, and you decide how to answer. A company of masons, out of work since their abbey ran out of money, asks to be taken on. The bishop's collector asks for a larger tithe than usual. Families from the neighbouring manor wait at your boundary, asking to settle.

  • Raiders and spreading fire — Raiders start arriving once the manor is a market town. They walk in from the edge of the map and set fire to the nearest building they can reach. Fire spreads between buildings that stand next to each other and stops at gaps such as roads. A well can put out one fire and then takes weeks to refill. To stop a raid, build towers and station soldiers in them.

  • Four neighbouring towns that keep score — Couriers arrive with export offers once the manor is a market town. Each town has its own temperament: one is demanding and quick to take offence, another is patient. Relations with each town improve or worsen over the years, depending on how you deal with it.

  • Four charters and five honours — Charters run from rich river soil to a lean northern frontier. Five honours carry the manor from Minor Lord to Castellan, each unlocking what follows: raiders and foreign correspondence at A Proper Market Town, border outposts and knights at Seat of Power.

Salty puts you at the eyepiece of a microscope, looking down at a single prokaryote adrift in saltwater. No nucleus. No defenses. No idea what's coming.

This game was born from a simple idea: let players experience the randomness of life while learning genuine cellular biology along the way. I noticed some of my young cousins always playing 1st person shooters, and they happened to be homeschooled. I thought, why not create something exciting, but learn something along the way, which would be a nice tool for homeschool parents. We take pride in offering a research-driven game where every creature behaves true to its real-world nature and interacts with others just as it would in the wild. Much of the experience is about engaging with nature, but it's equally entertaining to simply observe the mysterious world of microbiology.

A gentle, guided tutorial walks you through swimming, hunting, and building your first organelle; then quietly steps aside. We noticed that some players new to PC games struggled with standard controls, so we built a robust tutorial system for beginners, with the option to disable it entirely if you prefer.






Gather lipids, proteins, and fiber from the water around you, then spend them in the crafting ring to assemble real organelles — nucleus pores, ribosomes, mitochondria, Golgi bodies, lysosomes, endoplasmic reticulum. Each one you build genuinely changes what your organism can do, exactly as it does in a living cell.

Your progression is the biology: stack ribosomes to synthesize protein faster, grow a flagellum to dash, reinforce your membrane to survive rougher waters.





You are not alone in the water. Aggressive viruses hunt for cells to hijack. Larger organisms will run you down and consume you.

Fight back with real cellular weapons: engulf prey with phagocytosis, release an endotoxin burst to dissolve attackers, stun armored prey before striking, and dash out of danger with your flagellum. Learn what's dangerous. Grow strong enough to stop being prey.

Many more attack and defensive abilities are currently being worked on to increase the game engagement level. This is where we really need your feedback in our comments or to send a bug report in the game menu while trying out the demo.





Every species you meet is a real microorganism, recorded in your Compendium with its actual biology — what it eats, what it drops, and a page of true facts about the living creature. Discovery unlocks new DNA. New DNA unlocks new complexity. This game has advanced terminology and concepts that could lead to a narrow audience, but would be a nice bridge for those home-schooled teenagers and beyond to break up the monotony of textbook learning.

No quizzes, no lectures — getting good at Salty simply is understanding how cells work. The pop-up learning for discoveries is also an easy toggle switch in the game menu if your goal is to just play the game. All learning and tutorial systems have full voice-over for those that enjoy the audio learning focus.




From Garrack Gaming Studios — we build simulation games where the systems do the storytelling.

Recruit Three Kingdoms generals and build a team that fights on its own.

Each run is built from quick choices: choose locations, recruit generals, combine cards, equip items, trigger events, and shape your formation before the next clash.

Battles play out automatically, but victory is often decided before the fight begins. Frontline or backline? Faction bonuses or raw stats? A safe upgrade now, or a risky build that can snowball later?

When your lineup is ready, test it against other players’ teams in asynchronous battles and see whether your build can survive outside your own run.

Features:

  • Recruit Three Kingdoms generals and create a different team each run.

  • Arrange positions, faction bonuses, equipment, and skill combinations before automatic battles.

  • Discover unexpected builds through items, events, rewards, and card upgrades.

  • Challenge the single-player run or send your lineup into asynchronous player battles.

  • Fast to play, but every decision can change the next fight.

Sanslo: Spin of the Three Kingdoms

In this unique roguelite slot RPG inspired by Romance of the Three Kingdoms, recruit legendary generals, build your army, and conquer the battlefield.

Every spin shapes your strategy. Recruit powerful generals, equip rare gear, and unleash devastating skills as you battle increasingly formidable enemies on your journey to defeat Cao Cao.

Features

  • Recruit and command legendary generals from the Three Kingdoms

  • Roguelite progression with permanent unlocks and army growth

  • Conquer stages using a limited number of strategic spins

  • Unique skills, equipment, and character progression

  • Spectacular and over-the-top special move animations

  • Supports 4 languages: English, Japanese, Simplified Chinese, and Traditional Chinese

Can your army become strong enough to rewrite history?

Fantasy Interpretation

Sanslo is inspired by Romance of the Three Kingdoms, but is not intended to be a historical simulation. It embraces a lighthearted fantasy style, where legendary generals unleash wildly exaggerated special attacks and over-the-top abilities in spectacular battles.

Sanslo – Streaming & Content Creation Guidelines

We welcome gameplay videos, livestreams, and other content featuring Sanslo: Spin of the Three Kingdoms.

Individuals and organizations are free to create and share content without prior permission or notification.

Permitted Uses

  • Gameplay videos and livestreams on YouTube, Twitch, Nico Nico Douga, bilibili, and other platforms

  • Let's Plays, walkthroughs, reviews, Shorts, and other gameplay-related videos

  • Monetization through advertising revenue, donations, subscriptions, memberships, and similar platform features

  • Sharing gameplay screenshots and videos on social media

  • Using gameplay footage and screenshots for game introductions, reviews, and commentary

Prohibited Uses

  • Unauthorized redistribution or sale of the game or its data files

  • Making the game or its data files available for third parties to download

Game footage, music, and sound effects may be included in gameplay videos, livestreams, and content created to introduce or review the game.

We hope you enjoy sharing Sanslo with your audience in your own creative ways!

PLAY WITH FRIENDS

You were just a sausage. You lay there quietly, not bothering anyone... until suddenlyyou regained consciousness. Now you have mobility, unusual abilities, and one important goal: cause real sausage mayhem without becoming someone's dinner.

Use abilities, weapons, and other mechanics to get to places a normal sausage shouldn't be able to reach.

SURVIVE AND RUIN THE HUMAN'S LIFE

The house owner, rats, and other inhabitants aren't about to sit back and watch a sentient sausage scurry around the house causing chaos.

Evade your pursuers, hide, run, and use the environment to your advantage. Break the washing machine, interfere with the normal life of the house, and complete crazy tasks.

RUN, SAUSAGE, RUN!

Roll around the house, explore rooms, climb into unexpected places, and find new ways to interact with the environment.The washing machine can become a trap. Furniture is an obstacle course. An ordinary person is a formidable opponent.

And what's on the table might turn out to be a weapon. Explore this strange world, discover new possibilities, and discover the true capabilities of a sausage that's suddenly tired of being eaten.

Put your life on the line in a Sausage Duel

As a prisoner in a medieval world, you are forced into the Sausage Duels: a bizarre spectacle staged for the amusement of the nobility.

Sausage Legend Arena combines physics-based sausage combat with food customization, lineup building, and roguelite map exploration. Turn the ingredients you find into weapons and fight your way toward freedom.

Swing, bend, and collide

Wield a sausage skewered on a fork and land your next hit. Read its swinging tip, judge your distance, and time your attacks. Learn the shapes of different sausages and master the unpredictable clashes created by physics.

Prepare a winning three-sausage lineup

Customize your sausages with sauces and toppings to change their abilities. Bring three sausages into battle and combine their strengths to suit your playstyle.

Choose your route and prepare for the next fight

A branching map offers battles, shops, treasure, and events. Choose your path based on your resources and lineup, then prepare for tougher opponents. Unlock new options through repeated runs and discover new combinations on your next attempt.

Planned: online league battles for up to 8 players

We are planning an online mode in which up to eight players compete for the top of a league, with the goal of including it at Early Access launch. Basic online combat has been tested, but the league format has not yet been implemented or validated. Player count, rules, and availability may change based on testing.

Planned story content

We aim to include the full first chapter at Early Access launch and expand the story to three chapters for the full release. Content and timing may change as development progresses.

Sausage Snap is a close-up physics party duel. You are the hands at the edge of the plate. Two sausages on forks are the fighters. There is no swordsman.

Aim height. Jab. The meat sags, stretches, sprays, and snaps. Rounds are short. Sets are best of 3. Rematch is the point.

Play on the couch with two gamepads (or a pad and a keyboard), or sit down alone against CPU. One plate. One kind of fight.

The plate

  • Close-up sausage-on-fork physics — stretch, spray, snap

  • Aim height and jab (a second timing strike may join later)

  • Best of 3, then rematch in seconds

  • Local 1v1, or solo vs CPU

  • Keyboard and gamepad

What this is not

A stick-fighter. A movelist. An online ladder. Extra sausage types and doodle dressing are not in the first version.

Photosensitivity notice

This game includes brief bright flashes and high-contrast juice bursts on hits and at round end. If you have photosensitive epilepsy or are sensitive to flash, play with caution. There is no in-game warning screen before the plate.

Save Me, Hero! is a first-person card RPG with hand-drawn dark fantasy art.

Collect weapons and cards, grow stronger through Devour Deduction, talents, and forging, and uncover hidden secrets along the way as you battle and explore.

Face the Monsters Before You with the Cards in Your Hand

Step into danger from a first-person perspective, combining weapons, moves, and items in turn-based combat. Manage limited resources and plan the order of your cards so that your cards and gear work together.

Wield dual daggers to tear wounds open again and again, using Bleed to set up a finishing blow; or grip a heavy two-handed weapon and look for the right moment to unleash a burst of damage. Combine different talents to gradually develop your own combat style.

Choose Your Talents, Forge Your Gear

Visit the blacksmith, learn to forge, add sockets to your gear, and reroll its affixes, putting the materials gathered on your journey to use.

Choose talents around your favorite weapons and cards, then use gear affixes to strengthen your approach. Keep stacking Bleed, strike back after taking damage, or build up Defense while waiting to counterattack. Bring your cards, gear, and talents together into a build whose parts work in concert.

Devour Deduction: Create New Cards

Devour monsters to obtain Blood Spirits, then use the cards you have collected as materials to synthesize new cards through Deduction.

Turn the cards you already have into the moves your build needs, and prepare for the battles ahead.

Uncover Hidden Truths as You Explore

Cries for help in a village, belongings left behind by missing people, and conflicting accounts may all offer clues for further investigation.

Talk to the people you meet along the way, investigate what has happened to them, and decide how to handle the requests and conflicts before you. Offering help, trading, or making threats will draw different responses and affect your relationships when you meet again.

A Game Where You Break the Losing Heroine's Heart Again and Again... Just to Help Her Win!?

Save Ruika! - Looping with a Losing Heroine is a choice-driven romance visual novel where you enter the world of an anime and team up with your favorite losing heroine, Ruika Harumachi, to change her fate by making choices and collecting Bad Endings.

Cry, laugh, and loop your way through a high school romantic comedy with Ruika, a girl who refuses to give up no matter how many times she gets rejected!

● Story

In the final episode of the anime Kirameki★Actors, Itsuki Imai, a former child actor and the anime's protagonist, and Shiraha Fuyutsuki, the main heroine, are drawn together as though they were destined for each other.

But Ruika Harumachi, the girl who brought both of them into the drama club and tried harder than anyone to win his heart, ends up supporting their romance—only to have her own heart broken.

The last thing you see is Ruika sobbing alone in the clubroom.

"I want to save Ruika."

The moment you make that wish, you suddenly find yourself inside the anime.
Standing right in front of you is Ruika herself, moments after her heartbreak.
And then, somehow, the two of you leap back in time to the beginning of the story—
Now Ruika might still have a chance to become the heroine who wins!

Ruika asks for your help, and together you set out to change the story so she can end up with Itsuki.
Unfortunately, changing the story is easier said than done.

You originally planned to support Ruika from the sidelines, but before long, you find yourself joining the drama club, growing unexpectedly close to Shiraha, and causing all kinds of unforeseen changes...

Ruika's plans fail one after another. No matter how many times you start over, she somehow finds a new way to lose in love!

And yet, Ruika refuses to give up.
She cries, she gets mad, she picks herself back up—and keeps fighting against fate.

"No way! This doesn't count! Next time, I'm definitely going to win...!"

Can Ruika finally overcome her fate as a losing heroine and find her own happy ending?

● Characters

You (in the Anime World) & Ruika

Ruika Harumachi

The losing heroine of Kirameki★Actors.
Bright, devoted, caring, expressive, and fiercely competitive.

She was the one who invited both her best friend Shiroha and Itsuki to join the drama club—but in the original story, the two of them end up together, leaving Ruika alone with a broken heart.

She gives you the nickname “Cupy” after your sudden appearance and tries every scheme she can think of to defy fate and become the heroine who finally wins.

You (Name Customizable)
Default Name: Hikage Urakata

Choose your Hero and face an endless series of monsters, bosses, and increasingly dangerous encounters. Build your strategy, upgrade your character, manage your cards, and try to survive for as long as possible.

⚔️ Turn-Based Combat Without Mana

Forget energy and mana. Every playable card in your hand can be used during your turn.

At the beginning of each turn, draw 5 cards and decide how to use them. Attack enemies, heal your Hero, gain armor, activate powerful effects, or combine your cards to create your own strategy.

🃏 Build Your Deck Your Way

Your deck is made up of different types of cards, each serving a specific purpose:

  • Skills — Attack enemies and unleash your Hero's abilities.

  • Items — Consumable cards providing healing, armor, and temporary effects.

  • Equipment — Permanent upgrades that strengthen your Hero throughout the run.

  • Passive Cards — Automatically activate when their conditions are met.

  • Wounds & Scars — Not every card in your hand is helpful...

Manage your deck carefully, take advantage of synergies, and adapt your strategy as your run progresses.

🛡️ Master the Armor System

Survival isn't just about dealing damage.

Use Temporary Armor to absorb incoming attacks, then rely on Permanent Armor to reduce the damage that gets through.

Understanding how these two armor types work together can mean the difference between surviving another round and losing your entire run.

🩸 Every Wound Has a Cost

Taking damage can leave more than just a dent in your Health.

Open Wounds occupy space in your hand and increase the direct damage you take. Multiple wounds stack their effects, making an already dangerous run even harder.

Heal at the shop to remove them — or take the risk and let them become Scars. But be careful... a Scar can reopen.

💥 Critical Hits

Deal devastating critical hits — but only when your attack actually breaks through the enemy's defenses.

Some enemies can reduce critical damage, while powerful foes such as bosses may be completely immune to critical hits.

Know your enemy and choose your attacks wisely.

  • The game includes one chase sequence and a moderate level of jump scares. You can lower the difficulty of chase sequences or disable jump scares in the in-game settings for a stress-free experience.

    • Check whether any clues are missing.

Every card has three sticker slots. Add new abilities to change what a card does and combine several mechanics on a single card. With the right combination of stickers, even an unassuming card can become the engine of your entire build.

Battles unfold on a 5×5 grid. Cards normally enter play at random, but you can choose two to appear first and get your build up and running. Adapt to where each card lands, connect their abilities, and turn every placement to your advantage.

If a battle doesn’t go your way, retry it with the same deck. Choose a different pair of opening cards, develop your board along a new path, and find the strategy that wins the fight.

A run spans four weeks. Each week gives you only seven days, and the Boss always arrives at the weekend.

Battling and resting are always available. At the start of each week, you can also choose one of several random events and make it a repeatable action for that week. New random events appear each day as well.

Each action consumes a different number of days. Spend the whole week fighting, hunt for new cards, modify the ones you already have, or simply sleep straight through to the weekend. How will you spend your week?

After you defeat the final Boss, your winning deck is sent to the Gaol, where it becomes a challenge for other players to overcome.

You can also enter the Gaol to face winning decks created by other players. Bring your own deck, find a way past their setup, and climb the leaderboard.

WELCOME TO THE SYSTEM.

The mandate is simple: stabilize the numerical streams and prepare them for final dissolution. Do not question the process. The process is absolute.

The numbers have developed an unauthorized survival instinct. They perceive your cursor as a systemic threat and will actively scramble to evade your command. Insubordination cannot be tolerated.

You cannot force them; you must corner them. Leverage the "Social Cohesion" mechanic — when numbers gather into compliant groups, their panic subsides, making them easy to sweep into the sequence. Satisfy the machine's strict procedural requirements to maintain systemic rhythm. Failure to meet the quota results in immediate corporate restructuring.

Core Features

  • Numerical Anxiety & Instability

    These aren't lifeless digits. Every number possesses a "personal safety bubble." The moment your cursor breaches their comfort zone, they panic and scurry away. You aren't just solving equations; you are stabilizing volatile data that actively tries to slip through your fingers.

  • Social Cohesion

    Isolated numbers are flighty and unpredictable. However, there is strength in numbers. When specific mathematical groups huddle together, they gain "Social Confidence." Use the Synergy Indicator to identify these brave little clusters — once they feel secure in their groups, they lower their guard, making them easy to capture.

  • Beyond the Sum

    A total is just the beginning. Some folders want an exact count, some want ascending order, some reject repeats. Others run on formulas — where the same pair of numbers can fail or succeed depending on which one you pick first. Read the folder. The sum is rarely the whole story.

  • Tune the Static

    Play it clean, or let the system rot. Three visual intensity levels — from a crisp, distraction-free feed to a flickering, degraded CRT haze — let you dial in exactly how much chaos surrounds the math. Underneath it all, the sound never changes: paper shuffles, folders snap shut, clicks confirm every move, and somewhere a shredder hums beneath an ambient score that's calm and tense in equal measure.

  • Scaling Volatility

    Each level adds more folders, more conditions, more ways to fail. A sum becomes a sequence. A sequence becomes a set of rules stacked on top of each other. The numbers stay small. The math never gets harder. Managing the chaos does.

100+ cards, and a lot of them are a bad idea

You level up constantly and every level offers you cards. The plain ones do what they say. The interesting ones charge you for it — extra projectiles that each hit softer, lifesteal that permanently eats your max HP, a fire rate boost that ruins your accuracy.

Taking the bad idea is usually how the good runs start.

Every district is participating

  • Streets — the traffic is possessed. It runs the junctions on a signal you can't see and it does not brake.

  • Subway — the third rails go live on a rhythm you can learn. The trains don't care that you learned it. Then the lights go out.

  • Rooftops — gaps, crosswind, ziplines, and a long way down.

Each district has objectives you're free to ignore. Hold an uplink for sixty seconds while everything in the area comes to see what the noise is. Crack a supply vault and deal with what was guarding it. Walk a rescue pod to safety at its speed, which is not your speed.

Co-op, and nobody sits out

One to four players on a shared screen, locally or over Steam Remote Play Together. Any empty slot gets an AI teammate, so playing on your own is just how the game runs with a full squad of bots — you're not missing content.

Kill a boss and the squad gets one shared draft. One card, four people, everyone with an opinion. It goes how you'd expect.

Pick from the Courier, the Demolisher, the Lineworker or the Netrunner. They start with different weapons and want different cards.

The things at the end

PRIME WARDEN holds the Streets. LINE ZERO owns the Subway. THE ARRAY sits on the Rooftops. Multiple phases each, and none of them stop the district from doing what it was already doing to you.

Between runs

Scrap buys nodes on a skill tree. The Fabricator unlocks characters, cards and districts. The deck builder lets you throw out cards you never take, which makes every draft after that sharper. Worth doing once you know what you like.

Then it gets harder on purpose

Ascension climbs tier by tier. Each one changes a rule instead of adding a zero to enemy health. Clearing every district at the top is somewhere around 40-60 hours if you're good at this sort of thing.

About Early Access

The Early Access build has every district, every character, 100+ cards, a boss holding each district and the whole ascension climb. It's a complete game, not a slice of one. We're using EA to keep adding to it: more cards, more enemies, higher ascension tiers, and proper online co-op once the game has earned it. Local co-op and Remote Play Together both work from day one.

■ Contact is commitment.

A unit that ends its move inside an enemy Zone of Control does not get to wait and see. It attacks. That single rule removes the safest move in most wargames - sitting still and letting the other side commit first - and it changes what every step across the map is worth.
